# Protect Target URLs

## Goal

Enable **Encrypted URL** to prevent the user frontend from directly showing the real origin address.

## Suitable Scenarios

- Supplier portals.
- Special procurement channels.
- Customer backends.
- Internal systems.
- Private SaaS.
- Origin addresses that collaboration users should not know directly.

## Enable Encrypted URL

Go to:

```text
Site Management > Site List
Site Management > Inner Site List
```

Find the target site or inner site and click the "![](/images/site-config.png){width=22px}" button to enter the site or inner site configuration page, as shown in @fig-encrypt-url-checked:

1. Enable **Encrypted URL**.
2. Save.
3. Access again with a test account.
4. Verify that the user frontend no longer directly displays the origin address.

![Sa2web enable Encrypted URL](/images/encrypt-url-checked.png){#fig-encrypt-url-checked}

When users access the site with encrypted URL enabled from the frontend, the result is shown in @fig-encrypted-url.

![Sa2web encrypted URL](/images/encrypted-url.png){#fig-encrypted-url}

Open the browser developer tools and inspect the source. The link address is also encrypted, as shown in @fig-encryped-url-hrefs.

![Sa2web encrypted link](/images/encryped-url-hrefs.png){#fig-encryped-url-hrefs}

## Combine with Collaboration Links

Recommended flow:

```text
Collaboration content
  ->
SaaS site
  ->
Encrypted URL
  ->
Collaboration link
```

## Acceptance Checklist

- [ ] The user frontend does not directly show the real URL.
- [ ] The remote browser opens the site normally.
